HTML Notebook
=============

Summary: Open-source, OneNote-style web notebook where every note is a real standalone .html file stored directly in the user's S3-compatible bucket (Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, AWS S3) or an isolated Google Drive folder. Purpose-built for both human visual editing and AI/LLM agents that generate richer documents in HTML than in Markdown.

Canonical URL: https://htmlnotes-zeta.vercel.app/
Full AI Spec: https://htmlnotes-zeta.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
Sitemap: https://htmlnotes-zeta.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

Key Capabilities
----------------
- Native HTML Pages: Tables, callouts, inline CSS styles, diagrams, and rich formatting stay intact without Markdown lossiness.
- Bring Your Own Storage or Free Managed Tier: Start immediately on shared R2 storage or connect Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, AWS S3, or any S3-compatible endpoint.
- Separate Google Drive Sync: Connect Google Drive via OAuth (`drive.file` scope) to sync notebooks under a dedicated "HTML Notebook" Drive folder independently from S3.
- Local-First IndexedDB Persistence: Instant keystroke buffering in IndexedDB with 6-second background cloud sync and manual Save / Autosave toggle.
- Custom Order + Drag Reorder: Notebooks, sections, and pages preserve creation order and can be reordered by holding and moving items.
- Public Share Links: Generate revocable, optionally expiring `/s/{token}` links served read-only inside a sandboxed CSP.

Open Source Repositories
------------------------
- Frontend (`htmlnote-web`): https://github.com/tomar-ayush/htmlnote-web
- Backend API (`htmlnote-api`): https://github.com/tomar-ayush/htmlnote-api
